Printed page 1 is headed 汉字简化第一表, explains that parenthetical forms are the original traditional characters, and visibly lists 边（邊）. This verifies the exact pair and the date/scope applicable to it.

The attached original primary-source scans resolve the page-access gap. Table 1, printed p. 1, states that parentheses contain the original traditional characters and lists 边（邊）.
